property_summary: If the caller is jojoTeam then newEmergencyOracle must revert (i.e., only non-jojoTeam callers succeed) — this is violated by the mutant which inverts the check.
change_summary: Invert the require in onlyJojoTeam to reject jojoTeam and allow everyone else, changing who can call newEmergencyOracle and thus the observed newOracle after calls by different callers.
